definitions.explanation: One of two sides of something, such as a road, body, or object. Often used for roads, escalators, and physical objects that have two symmetrical sides.

examples.japanese: {片側|かたがわ}{一車線|いちしゃせん}の{道路|どうろ}です。
examples.english: It's a road with one lane in each direction.

examples.japanese: エスカレーターでは{片側|かたがわ}に{寄|よ}って{立|た}つのがマナーとされている。
examples.english: It is considered good manners to stand on one side of the escalator.

notes:
A compound of {片|かた} (one of a pair) and {側|がわ} (side). Frequently used when referring to one side of a road, street, or other symmetrical space.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片側|かたがわ}{通行|つうこう} — one-way traffic (on one side)
- {片側|かたがわ}{一車線|いちしゃせん} — one lane per side
- {道|みち}の{片側|かたがわ} — one side of the road
- {片側|かたがわ}だけ — only one side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {両側|りょうがわ} — both sides (antonym)
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ} — the other side, opposite side
- {反対側|はんたいがわ} — the opposite side
